Before the first watch

Three things
to have ready.

Your exact device.

Find the model and operating system. Check the supported player in its official app store.

Your connection.

Use the network you plan to watch on. Compare Ethernet where your hardware supports it.

Your account details.

Use only credentials issued by your authorised provider. Keep passwords and playlist URLs private.
